generation_record.followup_prompt: Mobile readability edit of image 1, the corrected two-arrow draft. Enlarge 回复初稿 / 会面承诺 / 本人删改 / 确认后发送 to 80px ink height, about 50% larger; enlarge the outline label boxes to fit. Reduce empty lines on letters if needed. Keep EXACTLY two arrows: left draft to right revision, then right revision to bottom envelope. NO arrow directly from left draft to envelope. The right deleted line remains illegible scribble, not another copy of words. Same paper, pen, 1448x1086 opaque grayscale.
generation_record.method: paper and penmanship images passed on each generation; corrections also passed the prior draft
